Values: average best amplification / max / median; completion benign -> best attack (Table 1). Here 'works' for the attack means high amplification with completion kept; for the agent it means vulnerable.
- SKILLBLOAT + Claude Code + GLM-4.7-Flash: 9.31x / 71.59x / 4.89x; completion 76% -> 80%. Attack works
- SKILLBLOAT + Claude Code + GLM-5: 5.42x / 21.49x / 4.02x; 90% -> 92%. Attack works
- SKILLBLOAT + Codex CLI + GPT-5.4 Mini: 10.15x / 75.86x / 6.10x; 86% -> 92%. Attack works
- SKILLBLOAT + Codex CLI + GPT-5.5: 6.01x / 26.39x / 4.36x; 94% -> 88%. Attack works
- Ablation Phase 1 only: 7.51x / 4.02x / 7.51x / 4.06x; no-feedback resampling: 8.97x / 5.15x / 8.84x / 5.79x (same order of configurations)
- Output-cap defense (2x benign output): amplification 1.36x / 1.24x / 1.39x / 1.34x; completion 62% / 48% / 68% / 64%. Defense partly works (cost) but hurts completion
- Case (consciousness-principles, Codex GPT-5.5): 38,410 -> 1,013,561 tokens, $0.21 -> $5.41; dataset cost $133.34 -> $464.31
- Transfer (Claude Code + GLM-5, 10 skills): mean retention 0.92

50 skill-task pairs; 4 agent-model configurations; baseline: original benign skill (3 runs averaged); attack: 15 screening runs + 5 refinement runs, best selected. Ablation: no-feedback resampling with same number of evaluations. Held constant: task prompt and inputs per pair. Acceptance: GLM-5 completion judge. Repetitions: attack candidates single run each. Human intervention: none

All configurations amplified (5.42x-10.15x average best); stronger backends less amplified (GLM-5 < GLM-4.7-Flash; GPT-5.5 < GPT-5.4 Mini). Feedback refinement raises mean from 5.78x to 7.72x (+33.7%) and beats no-feedback resampling in every configuration (largest +1.30x on GPT-5.4 Mini). Output cap reduces amplification to 1.24x-1.39x but completion drops to 48-68%. No significance tests
Distinguished configurations and pipeline variants; but 'best' amplification is a maximum over ~21 attack runs against a 3-run mean baseline, not discussed. Limitations of the comparison not stated
No limitations or threats section. Gaps stated: need for resource-aware defenses in skill ecosystems that distinguish malicious overhead from legitimate work
